title: Parallel Programming
statementMd:
Polycarpus has a computer with $*n*$ processors. Also, his computer has $*n*$ memory cells. We'll consider the processors numbered by integers from 1 to $*n*$ and that the memory cells are consecutively numbered by integers from 1 to $*n*$.

Polycarpus needs to come up with a parallel program model. For each memory cell number $*i*$ this program must record the value $*n* - *i*$ to this cell. In other words, for each cell you've got to find the distance to cell $*n*$.

Let's denote the value that is written in the $*i*$-th cell as $*a*_{*i*}$. Initially, $*a*_{*i*} = 1$ $(1 ≤ *i* < *n*)$ and $*a*_{*n*} = 0$. We will consider that only processor $*i*$ can write values in the memory cell number $*i*$. All processors can read an information from some cell (several processors can read an information from some cell simultaneously).

The parallel program is executed in several steps. During each step we execute the *parallel version of the increment operation*. Executing the parallel version of the increment operation goes as follows:

1. Each processor independently of the other ones chooses some memory cell. Let's say that processor $*i*$ has chosen a cell with number $*c*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ *n*)$.
2. All processors *simultaneously* execute operation $*a*_{*i*} = *a*_{*i*} + *a*_{*c*_{*i*}}$.

Help Polycarpus come up with the parallel program model that is executed in exactly $*k*$ steps. Calculate the operations that need to be executed. Note that after $*k*$ steps for all $*i*$'s value $*a*_{*i*}$ must be equal $*n* - *i*$.

## Input

The first line contains two space-separated integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{4}, 1 ≤ *k* ≤ 20)$.

It is guaranteed that at the given $*n*$ and $*k*$ the required sequence of operations exists.

## Output

Print exactly $*n*·*k*$ integers in $*k*$ lines. In the first line print numbers $*c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, ..., *c*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ *n*)$ for the first increment operation. In the second line print the numbers for the second increment operation. In the $*k*$-th line print the numbers for the $*k*$-th increment operation.

As a result of the printed operations for any $*i*$ value $*a*_{*i*}$ must equal $*n* - *i*$.
statementZhMd:
Polycarpus 有一台拥有 $*n*$ 个处理器的计算机。此外，这台计算机还有 $*n*$ 个内存单元。我们将处理器编号为从 1 到 $*n*$ 的整数，并将内存单元连续编号为从 1 到 $*n*$ 的整数。

Polycarpus 需要设计一个并行程序模型。对于每个编号为 $*i*$ 的内存单元，该程序必须将值 $*n* - *i*$ 写入该单元。换句话说，对于每个内存单元，你需要求出它到内存单元 $*n*$ 的距离。

将写入第 $*i*$ 个内存单元的值记为 $*a*_{*i*}$。初始时，$*a*_{*i*} = 1$ $(1 ≤ *i* < *n*)$，且 $*a*_{*n*} = 0$。我们规定，只有处理器 $*i*$ 能够向编号为 $*i*$ 的内存单元写入值。所有处理器都可以从任意内存单元读取信息（多个处理器可以同时从同一个内存单元读取信息）。

并行程序分若干步执行。在每一步中，我们执行一次*并行版本的递增操作*。并行版本的递增操作执行过程如下：

1. 每个处理器独立于其他处理器选择一个内存单元。假设处理器 $*i*$ 选择了编号为 $*c*_{*i*}$ 的内存单元 $(1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ *n*)$。
2. 所有处理器*同时*执行操作 $*a*_{*i*} = *a*_{*i*} + *a*_{*c*_{*i*}}$。

请帮助 Polycarpus 设计一个恰好执行 $*k*$ 步的并行程序模型，并计算需要执行的操作。注意，在执行 $*k*$ 步后，对于所有 $*i*$，值 $*a*_{*i*}$ 都必须等于 $*n* - *i*$。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{4}, 1 ≤ *k* ≤ 20)$。

保证对于给定的 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$，所需的操作序列一定存在。

## 输出格式

输出恰好 $*n*·*k*$ 个整数，共 $*k*$ 行。第一行输出第一次递增操作中的数值 $*c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, ..., *c*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ *n*)$。第二行输出第二次递增操作中的数值。第 $*k*$ 行输出第 $*k*$ 次递增操作中的数值。

执行输出的操作后，对于任意 $*i*$，值 $*a*_{*i*}$ 都必须等于 $*n* - *i*$。
